description: Change the enforcement mode of an existing budget, pause it, or ask to resume it. Use "alert_only" for monitoring, "soft_block" for overridable limits, or "hard_block" to block. "soft_block" and "hard_block" act only on LLM calls routed through the Metrx gateway (proxy); calls reported by the SDK or OpenTelemetry are never blocked. They are unavailable while the gateway's Cloudflare settings for budget sync are unset: the server then refuses them with 409 ENFORCEMENT_UNAVAILABLE and only "alert_only" works. Needs an API key with the 'admin' scope (an org owner or admin mints one in Settings → Security → API Keys); any other key is refused with 403 — then make the change at https://app.metrxbot.com/settings/budgets. Do NOT use to create new budgets — use set_budget for that. Requires an API key with the 'admin' scope.

budget_id.description: The budget configuration ID to update

enforcement_mode.description: New enforcement mode. soft_block/hard_block: gateway traffic only; 409 ENFORCEMENT_UNAVAILABLE while gateway enforcement is not configured

paused.description: true pauses the budget; false resumes it (refused while a hard_block budget is still at its limit for the period — raise the limit first)

name: metrx_update_budget_mode
title: Update Budget Mode
